canonical_title: Velaura AI raises $110M Series A at more than $1B valuation for low-power AI chip design
treatment: Covered as a material AI-infrastructure funding and compute-efficiency signal. Reinclude only for product deployment, customer wins, independent silicon efficiency evidence, major new financing, or acquisition/IPO events.
known_facts: Reuters reported on August 18, 2026 that Velaura AI raised $110 million and was valued at more than $1 billion.
The round was led by Seligman Ventures with participation from Capricorn Investment Group and existing investors including Samsung Catalyst Fund, StepStone Group and Maverick Silicon.
Velaura develops low-power chip and software technologies for AI data centers, edge and physical AI.
Its Titan Core silicon design platform targets lower arithmetic power consumption and data-center operating costs.
reinclude_only_if: Velaura announces production silicon, named customers, or major deployment milestones.
Independent measurements substantiate or materially challenge Titan Core power-efficiency claims.
A new material financing, acquisition, IPO, or strategic chip partnership is announced.
notes: Public funding report falls inside the 2026-08-18 12:00-23:30 JST night window.
